thin.derivation: N/E/S/W, roof floor-quarter bounds; same traffic cells, normal rails after removal; before/car/after.

wide.derivation: All headings and four lane-presence masks; right90 lane0, left90 lane1; center teardown, no roof or lane charge.

placement.derivation: Flat/reclaimable/bounds station predicates and exact thin/wide aligned SingleRailRoad eligibility, including accessory-only traffic rejection.

stations.derivation: All35 bundled declarations: exact dimensions/height/footprint, Int64 purchase, daily operation and subsidiary demolition; ownership/cut color/immediate construction.

removal.derivation: Caller car predicates, either/both/no wide lanes, independent lane removal, normal rail restoration and center/timer teardown only on legal whole removal.

hostRange.derivation: Inclusive expanded otherEnd(L) rectangle z+-1, full-height L actual columns, any structure voxel, dedup, direct Station stable-ID automatic choice.

hostGraph.derivation: Detach old parent, clear self, recursively disconnect copied children, then resolve target; same-host no-op; detached cycle/self/dangling rejection.

costs.derivation: Source grouped Int32 platform/demolition products before Int64 booking, base-only ground/water, relative upkeep, no-spend cosmetic/lane/remove operations.

drawing.derivation: Source selector and authored crop/anchor table for three materials, both lighting resources, all cardinal/up/down/roof/width combinations; no crop correction.

passage.derivation: Empty passage legal but no floating rail; orthogonal outlook/end flags, rejection, forward stair precedence and pure preview vs native invalid cast.

stopIndices.derivation: L4/N3..6 both directions, toward-zero negative division, no blanket overlength rejection.

yards.derivation: Exact fourteen P5 handoff inputs and outputs retained; independently checked here; host construction consumers remain P6-19.

capacity.derivation: Per-car invalid seated falls back to normal before aggregate packing clamp; Outside normal limit differs.

boarding.derivation: Original integer amenity product then float32 .01 and .3; packed cap, depleted/zero supply, three departures around decay, placed head origin.

fare.derivation: 3D truncated Euclidean fare checked at every Int32 multiply; missing/cleared origin; source station side effect order.

decay.derivation: Hourly float32 truncation and independently rounded daily-average constant, including large integer rounding witnesses.

tables.derivation: All 42 source arrays/1008 cells with base125 integer products/division, not compiler output.

providers.derivation: Ten concrete providers, weekday/Saturday/holiday/vacation/Sunday, entering/outgoing at07/17; residents separate and vacation divisor125.

nested.derivation: Nested nodes round before parent multipliers/addition; persistent wrappers preserve provider reference, no legacy activation.

listeners.derivation: Strict spherical listener-after vs inclusive cube station-after, 3D/equal/fifth order; separate reverse membership and removal notification. Dangling source aftermath is a diagnostic, never an admissible saved graph.

listenerDemand.derivation: Raw station split before ordinary land/XY/Z cap; special bypasses cap.

timers.derivation: Immediate station registration; hour/day alignment versus platform relative24h, independent cancellation without old-version conversion.

fifo.derivation: Equal-time FIFO with waiting/departing trains; hour can change boarding; day order changes today/yesterday; station and platform charges ordered.

logs.derivation: TransportLog fifth-root daily accumulation, Saturday fifth-power weekly result; nonlinear companion distinguishable from arithmetic mean.

expected.legacyFirstHourlyMigration: decay once, register aligned timers, unregister old handles, clear old fields

source.finding: Reach is integer sphere when listener attaches, inclusive clipped cube when station advertises; advertiseStation has no reach filter. Fifth-station replacement updates local list/removes old listener but does not register new station listener.
source.acceptance: Run both creation orders, exact/diagonal/z boundaries, one to five stations, remove/re-add and save continuation; record source behavior before approving normalization.
